result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth consistently outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 2.10% (15.83% vs 13.73%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 68.0% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.85 vs benchmark 0.68, Sortino 1.09.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 3.61% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.83).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-37.44% vs -37.92%).
Rolling return range spans -3.43% to 31.36% (34.79 pp spread) — consistency score 81.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
